name: IEX_STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT_MATRIX
description: IEX_STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT_MATRIX contains setup information about segments of Oracle Collections. This table is used to determine the appropriate scoring formula to use and strategy to assign to a subset or segment of delinquent customers.

columns.name: STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT_MATRIX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a scoring and strategy assignment by segment.

columns.name: STRATEGY_ASSIGN_MATRIX_NAME
columns.description: Name of the scoring and strategy assignment by segment.

columns.name: BUSINESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Collections business level at which the scoring and strategy assignment is defined. Valid values are Customer, Account, and Site.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the business unit at which the scoring and strategy assignment is defined.

columns.name: PROFILE_CLASS_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the profile class at which the scoring and strategy assignment is defined.

columns.name: SCORE_FORMULA_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the scoring formula for the scoring and strategy assignment.

columns.name: STRATEGY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the delinquent strategy group for the scoring and strategy assignment.

columns.name: LOW_SEGMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount overdue lower threshold. The lower threshold for the customer's amount overdue below which the below threshold strategy group is used.

columns.name: LOW_SEGMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the amount overdue lower threshold.

columns.name: LOW_STRATEGY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The below threshold strategy group. The identifer of the strategy group assignment when the customer's amount overdue is less than the amount overdue lower threshold.

columns.name: HIGH_SEGMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount overdue upper threshold. The upper threshold for the customer's amount overdue above which the above threshold strategy group is used.

columns.name: HIGH_SEGMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the amount overdue upper threshold.

columns.name: HIGH_STRATEGY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The above threshold strategy group. The identifier of the strategy group assignment when the customer's amount overdue is more than the amount overdue upper threshold.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the scoring and strategy assignment.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the scoring and strategy assignment.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the scoring and strategy assignment is enabled.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PREDELINQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the assignment is a predelinquent strategy assignment.

columns.name: PREDELINQ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Predelinquent amount threshold. A transaction is predelinquent if its amount due remaining is more than the amount threshold and it becomes past due in the number of days specified by the day threshold.

columns.name: PREDELINQ_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the predelinquent amount threshold.

columns.name: PREDELINQ_STRATEGY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the predelinquent strategy group for the scoring and strategy assignment.

columns.name: PREDELINQ_DAYS
columns.description: Predelinquent day threshold. A transaction is predelinquent if its amount due remaining is more than the amount threshold and it becomes past due in the number of days specified by the day threshold.
